changeDelegate.title: Change Delegate
changeDelegate.description: You are going to change your delegate from {delegate} to others, either to yourself or to other accounts.

joinDelegate.title: Join as Delegate
joinDelegate.description: You are going to participate in the delegation by converting your {amount} {symbol} to voting power. Please continue if you want to proceed.

user.aiStatement: An AI-powered delegate that actively votes on governance proposals. Learn more at <link>https://docs.degov.ai/governance/agent/overview</link>.

avatar.invalidFormat: Please upload a JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP image.

placeholders.delegateStatement: Your statement that shows your commitment to the community and what you will do for the community.

validation.displayNameMin: Display name must be at least 5 characters
validation.displayNamePattern: Display name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, underscores

tokenManagement.title: Manage tokens
tokenManagement.description: Wrap to participate. Unwrap whenever you need your tokens back.
tokenManagement.unavailable: Token contracts could not be verified. Refresh and try again.
tokenManagement.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero with at most {decimals} decimal places.
tokenManagement.approveHint: First approve spending for this amount only, then confirm Wrap as a separate transaction. Network fees are paid separately.
tokenManagement.wrapHint: Wrapping and delegation are separate transactions. Your existing delegation applies to newly wrapped tokens.
tokenManagement.unwrapHint: No approval is needed. Unwrapping reduces the voting power associated with these tokens; past proposal snapshots are unchanged.
tokenManagement.switchFailed: Network switch failed. Switch your wallet to the DAO network and try again.
tokenManagement.wrapped: Wrap confirmed. Your governance tokens are in your wallet.
tokenManagement.unwrapped: Unwrap confirmed. Your underlying tokens are back in your wallet.
tokenManagement.delegationHint: Holding governance tokens alone does not activate voting power. Delegate to yourself to vote, or choose a representative.
tokenManagement.existingDelegate: Your new tokens follow your existing delegation to {address}.
tokenManagement.snapshot: Changes apply to future snapshots. Each proposal uses the voting power recorded at its own snapshot.
tokenManagement.approvalFootnote: Approval is checked for the amount you enter.
tokenManagement.unwrapFootnote: No approval is needed to unwrap.
tokenManagement.participateHint: After wrapping, choose whether to vote yourself or delegate. Setting up voting is a separate transaction.
tokenManagement.unwrappedTitle: Your {symbol} is back in your wallet
tokenManagement.walletHint: Review and confirm the transaction in your wallet.
tokenManagement.confirmingHint: Your balances will update after the transaction is confirmed.
